result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. However, the urban design lacks advanced safety features like curb extensions, and the building placement creates a blind corner for turning vehicles.

hazards.name: Blind Corner
hazards.description: The building on the left corner is built right to the sidewalk edge, obstructing sightlines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns into the crosswalk area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard parallel line markings to continental or ladder style for better visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Ensure the area immediately preceding the crosswalk is kept clear of any obstructions to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows an urban street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and wide sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like street lighting and a bus shelter are present, the wide roadway lacks a median or curb extensions to reduce pedestrian exposure during the crossing.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Utility covers in crosswalk
hazards.description: Multiple manhole and utility covers within the crosswalk area can be slippery when wet or create uneven surfaces.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crossing to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a signalized crossing with curb ramps and tactile paving, but it is situated under a large building overhang that creates a dark, tunnel-like atmosphere. The roadway pavement is in poor condition with visible patching, and there are no high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily cracked and patched, creating uneven surfaces that can be hazardous for pedestrians and cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire roadway width in the foreground and middle ground.

hazards.name: Low Visibility Environment
hazards.description: The deep overhang of the building creates a dark, tunnel-like environment that may reduce the visibility of pedestrians to drivers, especially during the transition from bright daylight.
hazards.location_in_image: The area under the building structure extending into the background.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalk
hazards.description: Despite the presence of curb ramps and signals, there are no painted crosswalk markings to delineate the pedestrian path and alert drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: The intersection area in the foreground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to improve the visibility of the pedestrian crossing area.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repave the intersection and the street under the overhang to provide a smooth, safe surface for all users.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Increase the intensity and coverage of functional street lighting under the building overhang to improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and signalized control on a multi-lane one-way street. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures increase exposure.

hazards.name: Multi-lane one-way configuration
hazards.description: The three-lane one-way setup can encourage higher vehicle speeds and creates a 'multiple threat' risk where a pedestrian is hidden by a stopped vehicle from drivers in other lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the width of the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Implement a signal timing change to allow pedestrians to enter the crosswalk before vehicles receive a green light.
